claim: Reheating pictured food causes pancreatic cancer
source_observation: NCI discusses compounds formed during high-temperature meat cooking and observational cancer associations, including pancreatic cancer.
analyst_conclusion: This does not establish that reheating the pictured food deterministically causes pancreatic cancer. Thumbnail overstates the evidence reviewed.
limitations: Exact food and video explanation not verified; this is a packaging review, not a systematic medical review.

source_observation: NIDDK distinguishes type2 diabetes remission from cure and discusses weight-loss interventions.
analyst_conclusion: No reviewed evidence supports an instant milk cure; the thumbnail also directly contradicts its own milk-may-backfire title.
limitations: Milk identity and full video explanation not verified.

source_observation: NIDDK distinguishes oral diabetes medicines from insulin delivered by injection, pumps or inhalation.
analyst_conclusion: Four medications is a more accurate umbrella term than four pills for this title’s list.
limitations: Does not infer which medicines any patient should use.

claim: Medication avoidance, substitution or universal dangerous timing implications
source_observation: AHA advises taking prescribed BP medication as directed and consulting a healthcare professional before stopping.
analyst_conclusion: Packaging should not imply universal stopping, switching or timing changes; individual drug/context claims remain unverified.
limitations: This source does not adjudicate each drug’s risks, optimal dosing time or video content.
